en: Sepia-toned panoramic view of a coastal town built along a bay. Multi‑story neoclassical buildings line the waterfront on a curving peninsula, with more houses scattered on the low hills in the background. The shore is rocky with a narrow road following the edge. The scene looks early-20th‑century, with no modern high-rises. At the bottom edge there is faint white text in French identifying the view, and a small diamond-shaped printer's logo on the right. The web watermark 'www.elia.org.gr' is superimposed.
